post.description: Record one anonymous product event from the site. Disabled unless product analytics is on; send without credentials.

get.description: List owned conversations, most recently updated first. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

post.description: Create an owned conversation (at most 100 per session).

delete.description: Delete an owned conversation with its messages and runs.

patch.description: Rename an owned conversation. Foreign conversations answer 404.

get.description: List messages newest first, with citations on assistant messages. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

post.description: Ask a question and stream the answer as Server-Sent Events (`contracts/sse.schema.json`). Requires an `Idempotency-Key`; a repeated key returns 409 and is never replayed. Keep `X-Run-ID` to read or cancel the run. Send `X-Assistant-Progress: 1` for opt-in `run.progress` events.

parameters.description: `1` opts in to `run.progress` events (contract v1.1, ADR 020); any other value is ignored.
parameters.name: x-assistant-progress

schema.description: `1` opts in to `run.progress` events (contract v1.1, ADR 020); any other value is ignored.
schema.title: X-Assistant-Progress

get.description: Starter questions from the active public corpus for the requested locale (at most six).

post.description: Record up or down feedback on an owned assistant message.

get.description: Read the state of an owned run, for example after a disconnect.

post.description: Cancel a live owned run; idempotent, and a finished run is returned unchanged.

delete.description: Delete the session with its conversations, messages and runs, and clear the cookie.

get.description: Restore the CSRF token and expiry of the current cookie session after a reload.

post.description: Bootstrap an anonymous session. Requires JSON `{}`, a trusted `Origin` and `X-Session-Bootstrap: 1`; sets the HttpOnly session cookie and returns the CSRF token for later mutations.

get.description: Liveness probe kept from v1; it performs no dependency I/O. Prefer `/healthz`.
Readiness probe kept from v1: database schema, active corpus and graph. Prefer `/readyz`.
Liveness: the process answers, with the deployed source revision.
Readiness: dependencies answer; `schema_version` is the newest applied migration prefix.
